briefs.name: 2026-10-07-congress-trades-study.md
briefs.headline: Congressional trade disclosures: is there an edge? (Research Inc., 2026-10-07)
preview: **Verdict: No usable edge from the disclosure date after costs for a long-only swing desk on our 20 tickers. No signals.json changes.**

- **Pre-STOCK Act, positive but measured from the trade date:** Senate purchases beat the market by 85 bp/month from 1993 to 1998 ([Ziobrowski, JFQA 2004](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/journ
- **Rebuttal:** actual portfolios lagged the market by 2 to 3% a year from 2004 to 2008 ([Eggers & Hainmueller, JOP 2013](https://andy.egge.rs/papers/EggMueller_capitol_losses_jop_2013.pdf)).

note.text:
RESEARCH INC. ANALYST NOTE (2026-10-09)
SpaceX's low-band spectrum buy was the tape's real story: TMUS/T/VZ fell about 10–13% while tower REITs AMT (+9%) and CCI ripped, confirming the wireless-infra read-through.
Our Friday day ideas landed: HUM held an ~11% close on CMS 2027 MA star ratings, AMT and LITE finished green too. Telco and airline avoids did their job. Thu PLTR day was flat on the day then followed through; XOM swing only edged higher as oil cooled.
UMich prelim 46.3 (vs 48.1) with current conditions at a record low kept the soft-data caution on.
Next: bank earnings Tue (JPM/C/GS/WFC), UNH/JNJ same day; CPI Wed. Keep telecoms and fuel-sensitive airlines in the penalty box into the weekend.
Week scorecard (calls graded close-to-close): 3 wins (HUM, AMT, LITE), 1 flat (PLTR day Thu), 1 modest swing up (XOM). Congress-copy ETFs stay off the signal stack—filing lag and style bias, not skill.
